column1: # De Doctrina Christiana — chapter → printed-page crosswalk
# Derived from tools/crosswalk-output.txt (M0, measured against both scans).
# Offsets: la_pdf = la_printed + 16 · en_pdf = en_printed + 56
# la_pp / en_pp are the count of printed pages the chapter occupies, computed as the
# distance to the NEXT chapter's opening page. A chapter usually ends partway down its
# last page; the next chapter opens on a fresh page. prep-chapter.sh renders one page
# PAST the computed end on both layers so the boundary can be confirmed off the plate.
# flag column:
#   verified — chapter opening confirmed off the PLATE. Trust it.
#   ok       — agrees with the pdftotext layer (see tools/audit-chapter-starts.py) and the
#              La:En page ratio is sane. Not plate-confirmed; good enough to prep against.
#   suspect  — audit-chapter-starts.py found a mismatch, or the extent is implausible.
#              DO NOT trust. Confirm off the plate before transcribing, then correct this
#              file and set the flag to 'verified'.
# Sanity heuristic: En is normally LONGER than La (Sumner expands), typically 1.1–1.8×.
# A ratio below 1.0 or above ~2.0 means a boundary is probably misplaced.
# CORRECTIONS MADE SO FAR (both plate-confirmed 2026-08-03):
#   2.5 / 2.6 — the En II.v/II.vi boundary was wrong by 5 pages. The crosswalk had
#   II.vi opening at 598; printed 593 is the actual "CHAP. VI. OF ZEAL." page, and 598
#   is mid-chapter. That made II.v 19pp (1.7x) and II.vi 2pp (0.33x); now 14pp and 7pp.
